# CEDARS

CEDARS (Carbon, Energy Diagnostics and Reporting for Sustainability) is a free, open-source, browser-based platform for sustainability assessment and reporting across radiology departments and medical AI.

Canonical site: https://cedarsleaf.com/
Source code: https://github.com/takinci/cedars

## Primary workflows

- Profile: document the current Radiology Department or AI Model & Informatics assessment. Department Profile follows Context → Workflow → Clinical AI (optional) → Result (EcoLabel); AI Profile follows Context → Training → Deployment → Result (EcoLabel).
- Decision Workspace: model prospective changes without overwriting the current Profile; Improvement Potential remains separate from the current Footprint Score.
- Report & Share: carry forward the same Department EcoLabel or AI Research EcoLabel, then review Methods/evidence and save or share the assessment.

## EcoLabel method

- CEDARS uses a domain-specific **Footprint Score** plus 1–5 leaf Footprint Rating.
- Current Department and AI anchor ranges are **v1 provisional research anchors**, not empirical peer percentiles.
- Service/fleet references are contextual and do not currently alter the Score.
- The public **EcoLabel Method** page explains scoring, boundaries, Improvement Potential, and future calibration.

## Key topics

Radiology sustainability; medical imaging environmental footprint; medical AI energy and carbon footprint; healthcare decarbonization; radiology energy use; AI inference and training energy; cloud compute; water use; clinical AI; sustainability interventions; environmental reporting; EcoLabel; planetary health; cost; clinical care.

## Important notes

CEDARS is a research and estimation tool. Literature defaults are editable and local or measured values should be used when available. Normal calculator use remains browser-local; research contribution is an explicit optional action.
